propositions: The wiki-render hardening test intermittently kills its pytest-xdist worker on macOS py3.13 due to exceeding the 300s per-test timeout budget when under CPU contention

The test walks the entire committed corpus (884 renderable units) in a single monolithic loop, spawning ~1768 serial pandoc processes, measuring 91.6s idle and 504.8s under saturating load (1.7x past the 300s guard)

pytest-timeout with --timeout-method=thread calls os._exit(1) from a timer thread, killing the worker process outright without a traceback or assertion output, producing the observed 'node down: Not properly terminated' and worker crash messages

The fix chunks the equivalence test into fixed-size batches (parametrized by index) so per-test cost is bounded by construction regardless of corpus growth, reducing worst case from 504.8s to 38.05s under identical saturation
A coverage guard test asserts that all chunks concatenate to the complete unit set (884 units, >= 100) to prevent silent dropping of test cases

The byte-identity property and per-unit oracle comparison are preserved unchanged; only the test's execution structure is refactored, with no timeout raise, retry marker, or elapsed-time assertion added
